Edit the workbook (and save it in Excel so its values are cached), or WORD_RULES in the script, and re-run. Rune words: design/14 section 7 (Brent 2026-10-22). A skill is built on one base rune (skill_anchor); runes are added and linked. A saved word is rule-free (nodes + links, scripts/runes/rune_word.gd); 'rule_set' picks the rules in force from 'rule_sets' (each names a script extending RuneRules, plus its params). bond_v1 (scripts/runes/bond_rules.gd): single bonds; each rune makes at most its valence in bonds; a word is closed when every rune's bonds equal its valence. The electronegativity difference sets a bond's kind (bond_kinds, 'from' = smallest difference). Two base runes of different affinities bond only if the cosine of their affinity_positions is at least refuse_below; below weaken_below the bond is weakened. Universal runes have no position. Universal valence and electronegativity are PLACEHOLDERS (placeholder: true): Brent has not set them. Rune effects (layers 1-3, Bond Rules rows 19-40): each rune's 'effect' text and parsed 'ops', worked out by the interaction effects_v1 (scripts/runes/interactions/effects_v1.gd) from bond_v1.interaction_params.effects_v1; they change a skill only while its word is locked. bond_v2 (scripts/runes/ring_rules.gd, Brent 2026-10-23, design/14 section 8, Bond Rules rows 43-59) is in force: the word is concentric rings round the skill, one per level, sealed when a construct is bound into the skill; 'rings' gives each ring's fade and the runes it adds (ring_capacity says how 'adds' reads); a rune bonds only on its own ring and the rings next to it; strength = the ring's fade x the product of the bonds' transmissions on the strongest path; an ionic bond hands the weaker rune's effect to the stronger; shape_traits (closed ring, great ring, spoke, branch, balanced) are worked out by effects_v2 (scripts/runes/interactions/effects_v2.gd).

bond_v1.title: Bonds (first rules, 2026-10-22)

effects_v1.anchor_rule: The skill's own rune: its Effect names what the skill already does (Surge: the shove). Its bond factors scale that part of the skill, averaged over its bonds: bonded ionically to a stronger rune, Water Bolt loses its shove.
effects_v1.syntax: Effect syntax (one op per ";"): <group> x<m> multiplies every field of a stat group the skill has: power (damage), reach (range, radius, arc, width), speed, cost, reflux, windup (wind-up and recovery), duration, poise. Also: status <id> [n], shove +<m>, pull +<m>, marks +<n>, jumps +<n>, pierce +<n>, interrupts, braced, bonus <status> +<fraction>. Strength scales each: a multiplier m becomes 1 + (m - 1) x strength; an amount is multiplied by strength. A skill without a group's fields takes a quarter of the change as power instead, so no rune does nothing. New (2026-10-22): through - the hit ignores front block and shields. Planned rules for the build: a status a skill already applies adds stacks; jumps arc any hit on; braced works on any skill; poise on any hit adds stagger damage; duration also lengthens the statuses a skill applies; every skill's recovery counts as wind-up.

notes: A locked word changes its skill; an unlocked one does nothing yet.
Not decided yet: bond strength, unstable words, flaws, reactions between runes.
Universal runes have placeholder bonds (2) until Brent sets them.

bond_v2.title: Seals (structure v2, 2026-10-23)
bond_v2.structure: Each vestige binding forms a seal: a new ring around the skill. Forming a seal you may rework every inner ring and add the new one. Runes on a ring bond to their neighbours on that ring and to runes on the rings just inside and outside. A rune's strength = its ring's fade x the product of every bond's transmission on its path to the skill (each bond's kind factor, read from the side further out). An ionic bond hands the weaker rune's whole effect to the stronger rune. Ring 1 plus the skill's own rune keeps Brent's "level 0 holds 4"; each later seal adds 2 ("+2 per level").

closed_ring.label: Closed ring
closed_ring.needs: every rune on a ring bonded round it
closed_ring.what: the word holds itself together: the skill lasts longer

great_ring.label: Great ring
great_ring.needs: a closed ring of 5 or more

spoke.label: Spoke
spoke.needs: a chain from ring 1 out through 3 or more rings
spoke.change: reach x1.15 and speed x1.15 per ring past the second

branch.label: Branch
branch.needs: a rune with 3 or more bonds
branch.change: reach (area) x1.15 per branch rune, up to 3

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.needs: ring 1 full, every bond to the skill the same kind
balanced.change: the skill's own rune keeps all of its nature

effects_v2.strength_rule: Dominance must pay: an on/off effect (a status, an interrupt) also grows with strength, and in an ionic bond nothing is lost - what the weaker side gives up is converted into the stronger rune's strength. Example: Drown takes Wave (ionic) on Tidal Bore. Wave gives up all of its nature (reach, stagger, carry), so Drown's strength goes 1.5 -> 2.5: its interrupt becomes a 2.25 s silence and Dazed lasts 2.5x as long.
effects_v2.anchor_rule: The skill's own rune: its Effect names what the skill already does (Surge: the shove). Its bond factors scale that part of the skill, averaged over its bonds: bonded ionically to a stronger rune, Water Bolt loses its shove.

Also: status <id> [n], shove +<m>, pull +<m>, marks +<n>, jumps +<n>, pierce +<n>, interrupts, braced, bonus <status> +<fraction>. Strength scales each: a multiplier m becomes 1 + (m - 1) x strength; an amount is multiplied by strength. A skill without a group's fields takes a quarter of the change as power instead, so no rune does nothing. New (2026-10-22): through - the hit ignores front block and shields. Planned rules for the build: a status a skill already applies adds stacks; jumps arc any hit on; braced works on any skill; poise on any hit adds stagger damage; duration also lengthens the statuses a skill applies; every skill's recovery counts as wind-up.

notes: Runes are sealed when a vestige (or a later construct) is bound into the skill; the word changes the skill only once sealed.
Strength = the ring's fade x every bond's transmission on the strongest path to the skill.
An ionic bond hands the weaker rune's whole effect to the stronger one, and what it gives up becomes the stronger rune's strength.
A status lasts longer, and an interrupt also silences, the stronger the rune that adds it.
